summary_en: Eleven optional memorials are inserted into the General Roman Calendar on the occasion of the new Missale Romanum and Martyrologium Romanum: 3 Jan Most Holy Name of Jesus; 8 Feb St Josephine Bakhita; 13 May BVM of Fatima; 21 May Ss Christopher Magallanes and companions; 22 May St Rita of Cascia; 9 Jul Ss Augustine Zhao Rong and companions; 20 Jul St Apollinaris; 24 Jul St Sharbel Makhluf; 9 Aug St Teresa Benedicta of the Cross; 12 Sep Most Holy Name of Mary; 25 Nov St Catherine of Alexandria. Conferences may fix the starting date in their territory, not later than 1 January 2004.
excerpt: Cum gradu memoriae ad libitum erunt ideo peragenda: die 3 ianuarii, Ss. Nominis Iesu; die 8 februarii, S. Iosephinae Bakhita, virginis; die 13 maii, Beatae Mariae Virginis de Fatima; die 21 maii, Ss. Christophori Magallanes, presbyteri, et sociorum, martyrum; die 22 maii, S. Ritae de Cascia, religiosae; die 9 iulii, Ss. Augustini Zhao Rong, presbyteri, et sociorum, martyrum; die 20 iulii, S. Apollinaris, episcopi et martyris; die 24 iulii, S. Sarbelii Makhūf, presbyteri; die 9 augusti, S. Teresiae Benedictae a Cruce, virginis et martyris; die 12 septembris, Ss. Nominis Beatae Virginis Mariae; die 25 novembris, S. celebration.name_latin: Sancta Ioanna Francisca de Chantal, religiosa

summary_en: In the General Roman Calendar the optional memorial of St Jane Frances de Chantal is transferred from 12 December to 12 August because of the concurrence with the feast of the BVM of Guadalupe, Patroness of all America (second act of the same decree).
excerpt: Ob concursum insuper cum Festo Beatae Mariae Virginis de Guadalupe, Patronae totius Americae, a Summo Pontifice die 25 martii 1999 promulgato, transferenda erit memoria ad libitum S. Ioannae Franciscae de Chantal, religiosae, a die 12 decembris ad diem 12 augusti.

summary_en: Promulgation decree of the Missale Romanum, editio typica tertia (approved by John Paul II on 10 April 2000, in force from Corpus Christi 2000, published 2002): the book carries the General Roman Calendar and adds Mass formularies for the celebrations recently inserted into it; no calendar change of its own, recorded because the edition embodies the calendar.
excerpt: Aliæ formulæ adduntur pro celebrationibus in Calendarium Romanum Generalem nuper insertis. [...] Hanc editionem tertiam Missalis Romani Summus Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS II die 10 mensis aprilis 2000 auctoritate sua approbavit et Congregatio de Cultu Divino et Disciplina Sacramentorum nunc edit et typicam declarat.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Pius de Pietrelcina, presbyter

summary_en: St Pius of Pietrelcina (Padre Pio), priest, is inscribed in the General Roman Calendar as an obligatory memorial on 23 September, with the liturgical texts annexed to the decree.
excerpt: Summus Pontifex IOANNES PAULUS II eandem celebrationem in Calendarium Romanum inseri decrevit, statuens ut in posterum memoria Sancti Pii de Pietrelcina, presbyteri, quotannis die 23 septembris peragatur, adhibitis textibus liturgicis huic Decreto adnexis.
